description: Restores Trinity UI, platform and scoped self-development alongside the daily planner. Adds isolated preview DO bindings, truthful evolution PR states, recoverable stale preparation leases with compare-and-set result writes, verified orphan-branch recovery, ID attribute validation and retryable task cancellation. Renders completed workflow replies once from original Markdown to preserve links and generated-file cards. Includes regression tests; latest full-suite and live deployment remain unverified.
